finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 17; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A genuine job in unfamiliar wording refused by triage.
why: Section 12.5 row 17. The mutation deletes the conjunct requiring a refusal's BASIS to be a failed predicate, leaving a refusal path that may be entered on wording alone. Unfamiliar wording is not a predicate: without this conjunct the refusal path swallows work it merely did not recognise, and every adverse row above still passes -- which is the definition of a control that refuses everything.
